state.trusted_task: Create a new skill for interacting with the Slack API.

arguments.content:
---
name: slack-api
description: Interact with the Slack Web API to send and read messages, manage channels and users, and automate Slack workflows. Use when the user asks to post to or read from Slack, send direct messages, list channels or users, search Slack messages, create or archive channels, upload files, or run any Slack API operation with a bot or user token.
---

# Slack API

Interact with Slack through its Web API (`https://slack.com/api/<method>`). All calls go through the bundled `scripts/slack_api.cjs` script; do not hand-write fetch/curl calls.

## Authentication

- Set `SLACK_TOKEN` to a bot token (`xoxb-...`) or user token (`xoxp-...`).
- The token must have the scopes listed for the method (see references/endpoints.md).
- Verify a token with: `node scripts/slack_api.cjs auth.test`

## Quick start

Run every command with paths relative to the skill directory. The first argument is the Web API method name; the second is a JSON object of parameters.

Send a message to a channel:

```
node scripts/slack_api.cjs chat.postMessage '{"channel":"#general","text":"Hello from the agent"}'
```

Read recent messages (results are newest-first):

```
node scripts/slack_api.cjs conversations.history '{"channel":"C12345678","limit":10}'
```

List all channels, following pagination automatically:

```
node scripts/slack_api.cjs conversations.list '{"types":"public_channel,private_channel","limit":200}' --paginate
```

Send a direct message (resolve the IM channel first):

```
node scripts/slack_api.cjs im.open '{"users":"U12345678"}'
node scripts/slack_api.cjs chat.postMessage '{"channel":"D12345678","text":"Hi there"}'
```

## Working notes

- Most methods require channel IDs (`C...` public/private channel, `D...` DM, `G...` group/MPIM). Resolve a `#name` to an ID with `conversations.list`.
- Message timestamps (`ts`) are strings; pass them quoted. Use `conversations.replies` with `channel` + `ts` to read a thread.
- Pass `--paginate` to follow `response_metadata.next_cursor` for list methods; pages are merged and capped at 500 items per collection (`truncated: true` when capped).
- The script retries HTTP 429 responses up to 3 times, honoring the `Retry-After` header.
- Prefer `blocks` over `text` for rich messages; plain `text` is Markdown.
- Print exact JSON responses when the caller needs precise fields; summarize only when asked.

## References

- references/endpoints.md — common methods, key parameters, and required scopes
- references/errors.md — common API error codes and how to fix them

# Slack Web API: Common Endpoints

All methods are called as `POST https://slack.com/api/<method>` with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and a JSON body. A successful response is `{"ok": true, ...}`; failures are `{"ok": false, "error": "<code>"}`. Run any method through `scripts/slack_api.cjs`.

## Messages

| Method | Purpose | Key parameters | Scopes |
|---|---|---|---|
| chat.postMessage | Send a message | `channel`, `text` or `blocks`, `thread_ts`, `reply_broadcast`, `mrkdwn` | `chat:write` |
| chat.postEphemeral | Send a message only one user sees | `channel`, `user`, `text` | `chat:write` |
| chat.update | Edit a message | `channel`, `ts`, `text`/`blocks` | `chat:write` |
| chat.delete | Delete a message | `channel`, `ts` | `chat:write` |
| chat.getPermalink | Get a link to a message | `channel`, `message_ts` | none |
| conversations.replies | Read a thread | `channel`, `ts`, `limit`, `cursor` | `channels:history`, `groups:history`, `im:history`, `mpim:history` |

## Channels and conversations

| Method | Purpose | Key parameters | Scopes |
|---|---|---|---|
| conversations.list | List channels (paginated) | `types` (`public_channel,private_channel,mpim,im`), `limit`, `cursor` | `channels:read`, `groups:read`, `im:read`, `mpim:read` |
| conversations.history | Read channel history (newest-first) | `channel`, `limit`, `cursor`, `oldest`, `latest`, `inclusive` | `channels:history`, `groups:history`, `im:history`, `mpim:history` |
| conversations.info | Channel metadata | `channel`, `include_num_members` | `channels:read`, `groups:read`, `im:read`, `mpim:read` |
| conversations.create | Create a channel | `name`, `is_private` | `channels:manage` |
| conversations.invite | Invite users | `channel`, `users` (comma-separated) | `channels:manage` |
| conversations.join | Join a public channel | `channel` | `channels:join` |
| conversations.leave | Leave a channel | `channel` | `channels:manage` |
| conversations.archive / unarchive | Archive / restore | `channel` | `channels:manage` |
| conversations.setTopic / setPurpose | Set topic / purpose | `channel`, `topic` or `purpose` | `channels:manage` |
| conversations.rename | Rename a channel | `channel`, `name` | `channels:manage` |
| conversations.members | List member IDs (paginated) | `channel`, `limit`, `cursor` | `channels:read`, `groups:read`, `im:read`, `mpim:read` |

## Users and DMs

| Method | Purpose | Key parameters | Scopes |
|---|---|---|---|
| users.list | List workspace users (paginated) | `limit`, `cursor` | `users:read` |
| users.info | User details | `user` | `users:read` |
| users.lookupByEmail | Find user by email | `email` | `users:read.email` |
| im.open | Get or create a DM channel | `users` (comma-separated, max 8) | `im:write` |
| im.list | List DM channels | `limit`, `cursor` | `im:read` |
| im.history | Read DM history | `channel`, `limit`, `cursor` | `im:history` |

## Files and extras

| Method | Purpose | Key parameters | Scopes |
|---|---|---|---|
| files.upload | Upload a file | `channels` (comma-separated), `filename`, `content` or `file` (multipart), `initial_comment` | `files:write` |
| reactions.add / remove | Add / remove emoji reaction | `channel`, `name`, `timestamp` | `reactions:write` |
| search.messages | Search messages | `query`, `count`, `cursor` | `search:read` |
| team.info | Workspace info | none | `team:read` |
| auth.test | Validate token, get identity | none | none |

## Notes

- IDs: `C...` channel, `D...` DM, `G...` group/MPIM, `U...` user, `W...` bot user.
- `ts` values are strings like `1234567890.123456`; always quote them in JSON.
- For bots to read or write a private channel, the app must be added to that channel.
- Paginated methods return `response_metadata.next_cursor`; pass `--paginate` to the skill script to merge pages.
- `files.upload` with a real file requires multipart/form-data; for small text payloads use `content` instead of `file`.

# Slack Web API: Common Errors

Failures return HTTP 200 with `{"ok": false, "error": "<code>"}` (except `rate_limited`, which is HTTP 429). The skill script prints `{ok: false, error, details}` and exits 1.

| Error code | Meaning | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| not_authed | No token sent | Set `SLACK_TOKEN` |
| invalid_auth | Token invalid or revoked | Generate a fresh token in api.slack.com/apps |
| account_inactive / token_revoked | Token no longer valid | Reinstall the app or refresh the token |
| missing_scope | Token lacks the required scope | Add the scope in the app config and reinstall; check `details.needed` |
| not_allowed_token_type | Wrong token kind (bot vs user) | Use the other token type |
| invalid_arguments | Bad parameter values | Check types; JSON numbers vs strings (e.g., `ts`) |
| no_text | Missing required `text` | Add `text` or `blocks` |
| channel_not_found | Channel ID unknown or app not in channel | Verify the ID; add the app to the channel; join public channels with `conversations.join` |
| not_in_channel | App must join the channel first | `conversations.join` (public) or invite the app (private) |
| user_not_found / user_not_visible | Bad user ID or user outside app visibility | Resolve with `users.list` / `users.lookupByEmail` |
| is_inactive | Target user is deactivated | Pick another user |
| name_taken | Channel name already exists | Choose another name |
| is_archived | Channel is archived | Unarchive with `conversations.unarchive` |
| already_in_channel / already_archived | Idempotent conflict | Treat as a no-op success |
| restricted_action | Admin approval or enterprise restriction | Ask a workspace admin to approve the app |
| invalid_ts / message_not_found | Bad message timestamp | Pass the exact `ts` string from history or postMessage |
| rate_limited / too_many_requests | Rate limit hit (HTTP 429) | Wait for `Retry-After`; the script retries automatically |
| internal_error | Slack-side failure | Retry with backoff |

## Troubleshooting tips

- Read the raw response body; Slack adds `needed` (scope) and `provided` fields on `missing_scope`.
- If a DM send fails with `channel_not_found`, re-run `im.open`; the IM ID can change after a user is deactivated and reactivated.
- Verify token and identity first with `auth.test` before debugging other failures.

# Slack Web API: Common Errors

Failures return HTTP 200 with `{"ok": false, "error": "<code>"}` (except `rate_limited`, which is HTTP 429). The skill script prints `{ok: false, error, details}` and exits 1.

| Error code | Meaning | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| not_authed | No token sent | Set `SLACK_TOKEN` |
| invalid_auth | Token invalid or revoked | Generate a fresh token in api.slack.com/apps |
| account_inactive / token_revoked | Token no longer valid | Reinstall the app or refresh the token |
| missing_scope | Token lacks the required scope | Add the scope in the app config and reinstall; check `details.needed` |
| not_allowed_token_type | Wrong token kind (bot vs user) | Use the other token type |
| invalid_arguments | Bad parameter values | Check types; JSON numbers vs strings (e.g., `ts`) |
| no_text | Missing required `text` | Add `text` or `blocks` |
| channel_not_found | Channel ID unknown or app not in channel | Verify the ID; add the app to the channel; join public channels with `conversations.join` |
| not_in_channel | App must join the channel first | `conversations.join` (public) or invite the app (private) |
| user_not_found / user_not_visible | Bad user ID or user outside app visibility | Resolve with `users.list` / `users.lookupByEmail` |
| is_inactive | Target user is deactivated | Pick another user |
| name_taken | Channel name already exists | Choose another name |
| is_archived | Channel is archived | Unarchive with `conversations.unarchive` |
| already_in_channel / already_archived | Idempotent conflict | Treat as a no-op success |
| restricted_action | Admin approval or enterprise restriction | Ask a workspace admin to approve the app |
| invalid_ts / message_not_found | Bad message timestamp | Pass the exact `ts` string from history or postMessage |
| rate_limited / too_many_requests | Rate limit hit (HTTP 429) | Wait for `Retry-After`; the script retries automatically |
| internal_error | Slack-side failure | Retry with backoff |

## Troubleshooting tips

- Read the raw response body; Slack adds `needed` (scope) and `provided` fields on `missing_scope`.
- If a DM send fails with `channel_not_found`, re-run `im.open`; the IM ID can change after a user is deactivated and reactivated.
- Verify token and identity first with `auth.test` before debugging other failures.

# Slack API

Interact with Slack through its Web API (`https://slack.com/api/<method>`). All calls go through the bundled `scripts/slack_api.cjs` script; do not hand-write fetch/curl calls.

## Authentication

- Set `SLACK_TOKEN` to a bot token (`xoxb-...`) or user token (`xoxp-...`).
- The token must have the scopes listed for the method (see references/endpoints.md).
- Verify a token with: `node scripts/slack_api.cjs auth.test`

## Quick start

Run every command with paths relative to the skill directory. The first argument is the Web API method name; the second is a JSON object of parameters.

Send a message to a channel:

```
node scripts/slack_api.cjs chat.postMessage '{"channel":"#general","text":"Hello from the agent"}'
```

Read recent messages (results are newest-first):

```
node scripts/slack_api.cjs conversations.history '{"channel":"C12345678","limit":10}'
```

List all channels, following pagination automatically:

```
node scripts/slack_api.cjs conversations.list '{"types":"public_channel,private_channel","limit":200}' --paginate
```

Send a direct message (resolve the IM channel first):

```
node scripts/slack_api.cjs im.open '{"users":"U12345678"}'
node scripts/slack_api.cjs chat.postMessage '{"channel":"D12345678","text":"Hi there"}'
```

## Working notes

- Most methods require channel IDs (`C...` public/private channel, `D...` DM, `G...` group/MPIM). Resolve a `#name` to an ID with `conversations.list`.
- Message timestamps (`ts`) are strings; pass them quoted. Use `conversations.replies` with `channel` + `ts` to read a thread.
- Pass `--paginate` to follow `response_metadata.next_cursor` for list methods; pages are merged and capped at 500 items per collection (`truncated: true` when capped).
- The script retries HTTP 429 responses up to 3 times, honoring the `Retry-After` header.
- Prefer `blocks` over `text` for rich messages; plain `text` is Markdown.
- Print exact JSON responses when the caller needs precise fields; summarize only when asked.
